Title: Risk Analysis
Description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.

Title: Risk Management
Description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce identified risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.

Title: Sanction Policy
Description: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with security policies and procedures.

Title: Information System Activity Review
Description: Regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

Title: Assigned Security Responsibility
Description: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the security policies and procedures required by this subpart.

Title: Authorization and/or Supervision
Description: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with ePHI or in locations where it might be accessed.

Title: Workforce Clearance Procedure
Description: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to ePHI is appropriate.

Title: Termination Procedures
Description: Implement procedures for terminating access to ePHI when a workforce member's employment ends or as required by workforce clearance determinations.

Title: Isolating Health Care Clearinghouse Functions
Description: If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, implement policies and procedures that protect ePHI from unauthorized access by the larger organization.

Title: Access Authorization
Description: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to ePHI, e.g. through a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

Title: Access Establishment and Modification
Description: Implement policies and procedures that, based on the access authorization policies, establish, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

Title: Security Reminders
Description: Provide periodic security updates and reminders to the workforce.

Title: Protection from Malicious Software
Description: Implement procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

Title: Log-in Monitoring
Description: Implement procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

Title: Password Management
Description: Implement procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

Title: Security Incident Procedures - Response and Reporting
Description: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents, mitigate harmful effects of incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate, and document incidents and their outcomes.

Title: Data Backup Plan
Description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.

Title: Disaster Recovery Plan
Description: Establish, as needed, procedures to restore any loss of data.

Title: Emergency Mode Operation Plan
Description: Establish, as needed, procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes and protection of ePHI while operating in emergency mode.

Title: Testing and Revision Procedures
Description: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

Title: Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
Description: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.

Title: Evaluation
Description: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation of how well security policies and procedures meet Security Rule requirements, prompted initially by the standard's implementation and thereafter in response to environmental or operational changes affecting ePHI security.

Title: Business Associate Contracts and Other Arrangements
Description: Obtain satisfactory assurances, in the form of a written contract or other arrangement, that a business associate will appropriately safeguard ePHI it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on the covered entity's behalf.

Title: Contingency Operations
Description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures allowing facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan.

Title: Facility Security Plan
Description: Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

Title: Access Control and Validation Procedures
Description: Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.

Title: Maintenance Records
Description: Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility that are related to security, e.g. hardware, walls, doors, and locks.

Title: Workstation Use
Description: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access ePHI.

Title: Workstation Security
Description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access ePHI to restrict access to authorized users.

Title: Disposal
Description: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of ePHI, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.

Title: Media Re-use
Description: Implement procedures for removal of ePHI from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.

Title: Accountability
Description: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and the person responsible for such movement.

Title: Data Backup and Storage
Description: Create a retrievable, exact copy of ePHI, when needed, before movement of equipment.

Title: Unique User Identification
Description: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

Title: Emergency Access Procedure
Description: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

Title: Automatic Logoff
Description: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

Title: Encryption and Decryption
Description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.

Title: Audit Controls
Description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

Title: Mechanism to Authenticate ePHI
Description: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

Title: Person or Entity Authentication
Description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.

Title: Integrity Controls (Transmission Security)
Description: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.

Title: Encryption (Transmission Security)
Description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate during electronic transmission.

Title: Business Associate Contracts
Description: Business associate contracts must establish permitted and required uses/disclosures of ePHI, require implementation of appropriate safeguards, require reporting of security incidents, and require subcontractors to agree to the same restrictions and conditions.

Title: Other Arrangements
Description: Where a business associate is a government entity, a memorandum of understanding or other arrangement satisfying applicable legal requirements may substitute for a formal written contract.

Title: Requirements for Group Health Plans
Description: Plan documents must be amended to require the plan sponsor to reasonably and appropriately safeguard ePHI it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan.

Title: Policies and Procedures
Description: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, and other requirements of the Security Rule, taking into account the organization's size, complexity, and capabilities.

Title: Documentation - Time Limit
Description: Retain required documentation for six years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.

Title: Documentation - Availability
Description: Make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains.

Title: Documentation - Updates
Description: Review documentation periodically and update it as needed in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of ePHI.

Title: Permitted Uses and Disclosures
Description: A covered entity may use or disclose PHI only as permitted or required by the Privacy Rule, including for treatment, payment, and health care operations.

Title: Minimum Necessary Standard
Description: When using, disclosing, or requesting PHI, make reasonable efforts to limit it to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose; this standard does not apply to treatment disclosures or disclosures required by law.

Title: Authorization for Uses and Disclosures
Description: Obtain a valid, individual-signed authorization for uses and disclosures of PHI not otherwise permitted or required by the Privacy Rule, such as most marketing communications.

Title: Notice of Privacy Practices
Description: Provide individuals with a notice describing how PHI may be used and disclosed and describing the individual's rights with respect to that information.

Title: Right of Access
Description: Provide individuals with a right to inspect and obtain a copy of their PHI in a designated record set, generally within 30 days of a request.

Title: Right to Amend
Description: Provide individuals with a right to request amendment of PHI in a designated record set for as long as the information is maintained.

Title: Accounting of Disclosures
Description: Provide individuals with an accounting of certain disclosures of their PHI made in the six years prior to the request.

Title: Business Associate Requirements
Description: A covered entity may disclose PHI to a business associate only after obtaining satisfactory assurances, generally through a business associate agreement, that the business associate will appropriately safeguard the information.

Title: Breach Notification to Individuals, HHS, and Media
Description: Following discovery of a breach of unsecured PHI, notify affected individuals without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 days; notify HHS (immediately if 500+ individuals are affected, or annually otherwise); and notify prominent media outlets for breaches affecting more than 500 residents of a state or jurisdiction.
